# Berk Çapar

> Berk Çapar (also written Berk Capar) is a senior product manager at Pactum AI
> in Berlin, Germany. He owns the Supplier Engagement Platform, Pactum's
> highest-ARR product, which lets enterprise procurement teams run autonomous
> AI-agent negotiations with their suppliers.

## Facts

- Full name: Berk Çapar (ASCII: Berk Capar)
- Role: Senior Product Manager at Pactum AI, since September 2025
- Location: Berlin, Germany
- Experience: about ten years in product management, since 2016
- Domains: AI and ML products, autonomous agents, AdTech, MarTech, enterprise
  procurement and supply chain, B2B SaaS
- Education: BSc Industrial Engineering, TOBB University of Economics and
  Technology; Frontend Developer Certificate, Bilge Adam Academy
- Founded and exited StuntAI, an AI marketing automation startup (2023-2025)

## Career

- Pactum AI, Senior Product Manager (2025-present). Owns the Supplier
  Engagement Platform. Defines agent negotiation strategy: counteroffers,
  acceptance thresholds, supplier constraints, human-in-the-loop and savings
  models, used by teams at Walmart, Otto and Sandoz.
- StuntAI, Founder and Head of Product (2023-2025). Took an AI SaaS product
  from 0 to 1 through discovery, launch, monetization and a successful exit.
- Yara International, Group Product Manager (2023-2025). Managed three digital
  farming products, led three PMs and squads of 15 developers. Expanded a safe
  mixing guidance app from 2 to 12 countries, growing users 700%.
- Stack Overflow, Senior Product Manager, AI/ML AdTech (2022-2023). Launched an
  ML course recommendation product reaching 150M+ impressions and doubling CTR
  in one month.
- Experteer, Senior Product Manager (2021-2022). Led automated CV-to-profile
  creation, raising profile creation 25% and CV uploads 50%.
- Bond Digital, Senior Product Manager for Samsung (2017-2021). Led Samsung
  Galaxy Bizz, installed on 15M devices.
- Onedio.com, Product Manager (2016-2017). Built a self-serve advertising
  platform used by 50+ brands for 700+ campaigns.
